full.scope: Full pair certificates cover at most two insertions only under their native completion/one-optimal conditions. Motif certificates cover the blocker-count{1,2} leaf-bridge class only. Neither is a global optimum certificate.
full.gain_sum_note: Commit gains refer to changing states and different population members; they do not sum to the retained final quality improvement.

pulse-only.scope: Full pair certificates cover at most two insertions only under their native completion/one-optimal conditions. Motif certificates cover the blocker-count{1,2} leaf-bridge class only. Neither is a global optimum certificate.
pulse-only.gain_sum_note: Commit gains refer to changing states and different population members; they do not sum to the retained final quality improvement.

resource_policy: All quality results retained regardless of native CPU/wall qualification; failure/incomplete full-frame means are unavailable
mean_weighting_note: Ablation means weight all 24 prespecified graph-seed blocks equally; each of eight graph configurations has three fresh seeds. Diagnostics are separate.
inference_scope: Engineering observations from one reused AU-L002 physical mother source; neither graph configurations nor random seeds create independent physical sources
native_budget_definition: 360 native wall seconds, population4, one pinned native CPU/thread; actual native CPU/wall is separately measured
